name: Curse of Green Decay
body:
School transmutation; Level witch 4

Components V, S

Casting Time 1 standard action

Range Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./level)

Target One living humanoid creature

Duration 1 round/3 levels

Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

This loathsome spell slowly turns the victim’s body into a quivering mass of green slime. If the target fails the saving throw, he begins to suffer 1d4 points of Constitution damage per round while his flesh is devoured. If the victim’s Constitution score reaches zero, he dies. The decay can be stopped by a dispel magic or remove curse spell.
